# Summary of Editorial changes

This directory contains a list of changes between the 
upstream [OpenScore String Quartets](https://github.com/OpenScore/StringQuartets)
and this fork which is optimized for Optical Music Recognition (OMR).

For process notes see [edition.py](../edition.py).

Basically:
- many files have no substantial changes
- some have a few (some of which may be human error, corrected upstream)
- some have a very large number listed (probably a more systematic divergence not well captured by this process).
